address: Plaza de la Verdura 5, Pontevedra, 36002, Spain
bio: Found in the heart of Pontevedra, under the stone arcades of one of the most charming medieval squares of the city, we can say that this is a modern and informal tapería, with a dynamic proposal that combines traditional Galician snacking with more elaborate or modern dishes, where Iberian and Mediterranean flavours happily coexist with those from other latitudes. Here you will find octopus tacos, vitello tonnato panapuris, occasional Asian nods, and more). The dishes are designed for sharing!
